name: GovAuctions Data API
description: Structured government-surplus auction data. Live listings (facts only, no images) cover sanctioned federal sources (GSA Auctions) in the US. Sold-price comps and the proprietary GovAuctions Flip Score resale signal are derived aggregates; comps cover the full surplus market in US, UK, CA, AU, DE, FR (/sources lists each market's archive size). Every plan carries two budgets: total calls, and a smaller valuation allowance that the valuation endpoints (/comps, /comps/batch per query, /sold, /comps/trend, /flip-score) draw down — see the X-Valuation-* response headers, or call /usage to read both budgets directly. Past the monthly valuation allowance, a key that holds prepaid credits spends one per valuation call; a call that returns no answer (empty, not priceable, or an error) costs nothing from either. Listing prices and bid counts are refreshed on a twice-daily ingest (about 06:00 and 18:00 UTC); the listing endpoints serve that snapshot rather than polling the source per request, so a lot's bid can be up to ~12h behind. Check /coverage before building on the comp endpoints: it reports what we can and cannot price. Plans: Free (free); Pay as you go (prepaid credits from $10 for 500 valuation calls); Enterprise (contact us). Get a key at https://govauctions.app/developers.
